## Checkpoints

<details class="guide-section"><summary>01 · Scope</summary>

**Evidence:** Question, dataset version, acceptance criteria.

**Decide:** Is the scope achievable?

</details>

<details class="guide-section"><summary>02 · Inputs</summary>

**Evidence:** Input manifest, metadata, quality notes.

**Decide:** Is the scan suitable?

</details>

<details class="guide-section"><summary>03 · Segmentation</summary>

**Evidence:** Versions, command, logs, anatomical overlays.

**Decide:** Accept the pilot or request changes before scaling.

</details>

<details class="guide-section"><summary>04 · Measurements</summary>

**Evidence:** Region table, units, provenance, participant joins.

**Decide:** Are measures and joins correct?

</details>

<details class="guide-section"><summary>05 · Analysis</summary>

**Evidence:** Model plan, assumptions, uncertainty, figures.

**Decide:** Are the claims supported?

</details>

<details class="guide-section"><summary>06 · Handover</summary>

**Evidence:** Reproduction steps, output locations, known failures.

**Decide:** Can someone repeat the accepted work?

</details>

:::

<p class="small-note">Shared status lives in GitHub.</p>
<details class="guide-section"><summary>Placement setup</summary>

- Create one assigned task with the dataset accession and fixed snapshot, exact subject ID, task ID, Colab notebook, expected outputs, and due date.
- Share a separate Google Drive output folder directly with that student. Give them the exact shortcut name; keep folders for different students separate.
- GitHub issues in this public repository are public. Keep private Drive links and personal information out of issues and comments.
- Review the run ID, QC status, provenance, logs, and outputs in Drive. Copy accepted outputs into supervisor-owned storage; the student owns files they upload to a My Drive folder.
- The website checklist is local to each browser. It does not provide student/supervisor logins or shared progress.

[Student workspace](student.qmd) · [Contribution guide](https://github.com/Donggyurim/neuroimaging-training/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)

</details>
